# Circe Docs

> Technical writing by Avalynn Circe, developer and documentation engineer. Markdown in Git, built and checked by CI, deployed to GitHub Pages.

## Pages

- [Building a Weather-Aware AI Skill with Xweather + Claude](https://avalynn-circe.github.io/circe-docs/xweather-skill): A tutorial on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), Claude Skills, the Vaisala Xweather MCP server, and an activity-matrix parameter file.
- [Reviewing the MCP server tutorial as the developer it was written for](https://avalynn-circe.github.io/circe-docs/mcp-tutorial-review): A review of the official "Build an MCP server" quickstart. Ten findings (R-01 to R-10), a rewritten Python section, and a test results table.

## Optional

- [Circe Editorial Standard rules enforced on this site](https://github.com/avalynn-circe/circe-docs/tree/main/styles/Circe): Vale rule files, one per rule.
